titleStmt.title: Kephalaia of the Teacher, edition page 42: diplomatic and Leiden transcription

sourceDesc.bibl: Kephalaia (Manichäische Handschriften der Staatlichen Museen Berlin), ed. H. J. Polotsky and A. Böhlig, Stuttgart: Kohlhammer, 42. Restorations, sublinear dots, gap counts and corrections are the editors'.

encodingDesc.p: EpiDoc. Read by eye from the page image; gap counts, sublinear dots and supralinear stroke extents verified by measurement on the image. A supralinear stroke is marked on every letter it covers by at least half its width. Spaces are the edition's word division. Facsimile zones are measured line centres. The editors' German statements are not transcribed: each is mapped to an id of the controlled vocabulary data/kephalaia/editorial_vocabulary.json and carried as @ana (ed: statements in the text, app: apparatus footnotes, tr: categories of the transcriber's commentary).

div.p: The framed manuscript page number ⲙⲃ (top left) is printed with a bar above and below as the frame, not as a supralinear stroke. Measured stroke over the first ⲙⲛ (663–682, pixel row): ⲙ 47 %, ⲛ 46 %; the bar is centred on the join and covers neither letter by half, so it is encoded on both (ledger §3, decided 2026-11-15 on this line). Stroke over ⲛ of ⲛⲟⲩⲛⲉⲙ (822–835); the second ⲙⲛ has none.
Strokes over ⲛ of ⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ (737–750) and ⲛ of ⲛⲭⲉⲓⲣⲟⲧⲟⲛⲓⲁ (1030–1042). Measured stroke over ⲙⲛ (871–891, pixel row): ⲙ 59 %, ⲛ 54 %, encoded on both.
Strokes over ⲛ of ⲣⲟⲩϭⲛ (615–628), ⲛ of ⲛⲁϩⲣⲛ (1023–1036) and ⲛ of ⲛⲟⲩ (1254–1267). Dots under ⲟ (x 567) and ⲩ (581, area 4) of ⲣⲟⲩϭⲛ, clear at 8×; reconcile does not count the second (area < 6).

Measured strokes over the second ⲙⲛ (903–923: ⲙ 53 %, ⲛ 54 %) and the third ⲙⲛ (1104–1124: ⲙ 53 %, ⲛ 62 %), both encoded on both letters.
